finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/board/is-editable-target.ts::board adoption conflicts with a documented board design decision. `packages/frontend/src/app/board/is-editable-target.ts:6-13` states the button branch exists specifically "so space on a focused `boardtoolbar` toggle still activates the button instead of entering pan mode". blurring toolbar buttons to `document.body` after every pointer-driven click means the next space now enters board pan mode rather than re-activating the just-used toggle — a behaviour change to board pan-mode that no doc under `docs/design/board/` records.
evidence: Verified: board-toolbar.tsx calls useCanvasFocusRelease() and sets data-canvas-toolbar, despite the PR's own todo doc listing board adoption as out of scope and the design doc calling it deferred. Tracing toolbar-focus-release.ts, a pointer-clicked BoardToolbar toggle (data-state="on" doesn't match the "open" guard, lines 61-66) is released to document.body, so the next Space keydown targets the body and BoardView's pan-mode shortcut fires instead of re-activating the toggle — exactly contradicting the documented rationale at is-editable-target.ts:6-13. The behavior change is real and undocumented for the board surface, though keyboard (Tab) focus is preserved and the new behavior may arguably be desirable, which caps severity at minor.
